scientific_integrity: Original claimed result is the exact spherical antipodal-pair mean, with a directly proved structural classification. Spherical hyperplane density and centrally symmetric polytope background are credited mathematical inputs. Computational corroboration does not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly five independent uniform antipodal pairs on S^3. No complete distribution over the five face-vector classes, other sample sizes or dimensions. The deterministic classification may follow older Gale-diagram theory; priority of the explicit stochastic mean remains provisional.
title: Exact facet mean and five face-vector classes of an antipodal random four-polytope
